description: Adds permissions to the resource-based policy of a version of an Lambda layer. Use this action to grant layer usage permission to other accounts. You can grant permission to a single account, all accounts in an organization, or all Amazon Web Services accounts.

researchLinks.description: "But without PassRole it should be fine", Lambda edition

securityImplications: Attackers might use AddLayerVersionPermission to share a malicious Lambda layer from their account with a victim account, so the victim function can attach it and run the attacker's code under its execution role.

simulation.value: aws lambda add-layer-version-permission --layer-name TrailDiscover --version-number 1 --statement-id share --action lambda:GetLayerVersion --principal 111111111111
